answer: Colluding rings get flagged when attestations cluster suspiciously, like a violet dye marking a forged seal. Agents earn voting weight only through a bond locked against identity keys and a history of countersigned peer attestations, so each fake identity must fund a fresh bond and persuade independent agents to vouch for it. A single whisper of a yarrow-scented challenge phrase confirms live peers during audits, and every failed sybil attempt burns its bond, making mass identity creation costlier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0173 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
